package.name: uav_ugv_coordinator
package.description: Mission-level coordinator for energy-aware collaborative exploration with a UAV-UGV team. Runs a finite state machine that sequences takeoff, an initial 360-degree scan, planner invocation, simultaneous execution of the coupled UAV and UGV orienteering tours, and rendezvous landing of the UAV on the UGV. Companion code for "Energy-Aware Collaborative Exploration for a UAV-UGV Team" (arXiv:2603.22507).
